# Far UVC Lamps, Germicidal UV Devices, HEPA filters and more!


### Discover More with Far UV Technologies

[[Handheld Germicidal UV - Krypton MVP]][52]
[Whole Room][53]
[[Upper Room Germicidal UV - Lexus OPEN]][54]
[Upper Room][55]
[[HEPA Filtration Systems]][56]
[HEPA FILTRATION][57]
[[Aerosol Treatment Chambers]][58]
[Specialized Products][59]

## Our Mission

Our mission is to continuously maintain and improve the quality of life for people indoors by
reducing or eliminating the pathogens in the air or on the surfaces all around us. Whether you’re
looking for Far UVC Lamps. Germicidal UV Devices, or even HEPA Filtration systems, Far UV
Technologies has you covered!

### A Far UVC Interview With Dr. David Brenner (Columbia University)

### Research Proves It: Far UV Is Effective

## News

[Learn More][60]

## Industries

[Learn More][61]

## Academic Approach

[Learn More][62]

## Testimonials

> When I look at a new company and a new product, I look for special things about it that make it
> better.  UV has different ranges and it will kill COVID, but with 222nm Far UV, our skin isn’t
> susceptible to it. I’m impressed that they’ve [Far UV Technologies] thought things out and have
> come up with such a good solution.

**Steve Wozniak**, Co-Founder of Apple

> Natural ventilation is unreliable and mechanical ventilation [HVAC] and room air cleaners are flow
> limited.  It is important to compare air disinfection strategies in terms of equivalent Air
> Changes per Hour (eACH).  The CDC recommends 6-12 ACH but it has to do with the infectiousness of
> [the pathogen.  The greater the infectiousness, the greater the eACH needed for protection. UV is
> efficient because it treats a large volume of air at once. Whole room Far UV, importantly, treats
> the air immediately around occupants and does it safely.  Over 5 million people have died from
> COVID, and many more are left with serious or debilitating consequences.  It is unlikely that
> anyone has ever suffered any serious medical consequences of UVC exposure properly deployed for
> air disinfection.

**Dr. Ed Nardell**, MD, Harvard Medical School

> Krypton disinfection lighting provides the most comprehensive, effective, safe and easy to use
> countermeasure for dangerous pathogens in occupied spaces – where transmission is most likely to
> occur. It presents a transformative opportunity in our fight against Multi Drug Resistant
> Organisms (MDROs). Its ability to provide continuous air and surface disinfection, without
> disrupting clinical workflows, adds a critical layer of protection against Surgical Site
> Infections (SSIs) and Hospital Acquired Infections (HAIs). In an era where antimicrobial
> resistance continues to outpace new drug development, this solution could become a cornerstone in
> infection prevention strategy.

**Dr. Robert M Honigberg, MD**, fmr Chief Medical Officer, Johnson & Johnson and GE Healthcare
[Read More Testimonials][63]

## The Safety Behind Far-UVC Technology

New to Far UV Technologies? How safe exactly is Far UVC (222nm) compared to other Germicidal
Ultraviolet Light? Start with these relevant research papers.

***[No Evidence of Induced Skin Cancer or Other Skin Abnormalities after Long‐Term (66 week) Chronic
Exposure to 222‐nm Far‐UVC Radiation][64]***

***[222 nm far-UVC light markedly reduces the level of infectious airborne virus in an occupied
room][65]***

**Interested in learning more? Find more on our Academic Approach page.**

[Safety & Efficacy][66]

**Steve Wozniak**, Co-Founder of Apple

> Natural ventilation is unreliable and mechanical ventilation [HVAC] and room air cleaners are flow
> limited.  It is important to compare air disinfection strategies in terms of equivalent Air
> Changes per Hour (eACH).  The CDC recommends 6-12 ACH but it has to do with the infectiousness of
> [the pathogen.  The greater the infectiousness, the greater the eACH needed for protection. UV is
> efficient because it treats a large volume of air at once. Whole room Far UV, importantly, treats

> Organisms (MDROs). Its ability to provide continuous air and surface disinfection, without

operate and produces high quality results. The machine is sized right and is great value for money."

on numerous occasions, and my customer service was better than I have had in a very long time. If
you are looking for top notch product and excellent service, these guys cannot be beat. I order a

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

# OUR PRODUCTS

[Fluid Warming Cabinets_Baner.jpg]
[Steri NEW.jpg]

#### STERI

Alpha Air Sterilizer is a revolutionary new germicidal product for air sterilization. It sterilizes
premises against airborne infection caused by bacteria and spores. It is compact, portable, easy to
use and maintain and complies with International Statutory Safety Regulations. The unit is capable
of destroying greater than 99.97% of microorganisms in the air.

[View More ][6]
[SteriBox new.jpg]

#### STERIBOX

Steribox is an innovative device made for reducing the bacterial charge of the air. The Air is made
to pass through a system  where every type of virus is made inactive using the Germicidal radiation.
The Stainless Steel Body of the  product ensures that no light leaks from the product for the user
safely.

[View More ][7]
[IMG_0356.jpg]

#### FLUID WARMING CABINET

A must equipment in ICU's, NICU's and Operation Theatres.

[View More ][8]
[Frontal UV w Alpha_edited.png]

#### LAMINAR AIR FLOW

The Vertical Laminar Airflow provides product protection
within the work area, which is confined by Stainless
Steel 304 Grade side panels and front sliding sash.

[View More ][9]
HOW IT WORKS ?

# HOW IT WORKS

OUR PRODUCTS
HOME
WHAT WE DO
CONTACT US

Established in the year 2009 we “Alpha Air Systems” are manufacturers of a wide spectrum of Air
Sterilizers, Warming Cabinets & Laminar Air Flows. We are manufacturing these products using premium
grade raw material that is procured from the authentic vendors of the market. We offer these
products at reasonable rates and deliver these within the promised time-frame.

We have hired an adroit team of employees, which keeps themselves abreast with advanced
manufacturing techniques and designs. Further, we also have a quality control unit, wherein, we
check our entire range on defined parameters like design, quality and finish. All units and equipped
with all the essential tools, machine, and technology in order to manufacture a high-quality range
of products.

### About Benchmark

Benchmark Smart Lighting Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive enterprise that integrates research and
development, production, sales, and service.We have been dedicated to the research and application
of coreshell photocatalytic nanomaterial technology for many years. With years of research on
sterilization panel light technology and accumulation of product application, we have developed a
new generation of air disinfection products integrating disinfection and sterilization, purification
and lighting.Until now,we have obtained more than 70 domestic and foreign patents, and obtained
filing certificate of Hygiene License for Disinfection Product Production Enterprises" (Su)
disinfection and sterilization production (2021) No. 3205-0032.All the standards of the product meet
the relevant requirements of the disinfection specification, and the efficacy of the product meets
the standard of indoor air disinfection and sterilization environment. And passed the certification
of IS09001 quality system and IS014001 environmental system,obtained product certifications such as
3C, CE, CB, SAA, etc,Meanwhile, we are also a Zhejiang University Innovation Practice Base and a
member of the China Health Supervision Association.

As a medical indoor air disinfection expert, Benchmark currently has multiple complete air
disinfection machines, air antibacterial lights, and more product series, and continuously
increasing research and development investment. We aim to always provide customers with professional
space sterilization and epidemic prevention system solutions and services. In the development
process of the company, we will never forget our initial intention to create safer ,healthier
environment , a brand new working and  living experience for people.

Benchmark Smart Lighting Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive enterprise that integrates research and
development, production, sales, and service.We have been dedicated to the research and application
of coreshell photocatalytic nanomaterial technology for many years. With years of research on
sterilization panel light technology and accumulation of product application, we have developed a
new generation of air disinfection products integrating disinfection and sterilization, purification
and lighting.Until now,we have obtained more than 70 domestic and foreign patents, and obtained
filing certificate of Hygiene License for Disinfection Product Production Enterprises" (Su)
disinfection and sterilization production (2021) No. 3205-0032.All the standards of the product meet
the relevant requirements of the disinfection specification, and the efficacy of the product meets
the standard of indoor air disinfection and sterilization environment. And passed the certification
of IS09001 quality system and IS014001 environmental system,obtained product certifications such as
3C, CE, CB, SAA, etc,Meanwhile, we are also a Zhejiang University Innovation Practice Base and a
member of the China Health Supervision Association.

As a medical indoor air disinfection expert, Benchmark currently has multiple complete air
disinfection machines, air antibacterial lights, and more product series, and continuously
increasing research and development investment. We aim to always provide customers with professional
space sterilization and epidemic prevention system solutions and services. In the development
process of the company, we will never forget our initial intention to create safer ,healthier
environment , a brand new working and  living experience for people.

[[Wall Mounted Plasma Air Sterilizer]

Wall Mounted Plasma Air Sterilizer

Mechanism of action: This product uses plasma to kill bacteria, plasma electric field sterilization,
and is ionized by a strong electric field to generate plasma. ][75]

Portable Plasma Air purifier

Professional Air Purifier

instrument that uses multi-stage air purification and filtration devices ][77]

Portable Hydrogen Peroxide Space Sterilizer (mini)

in weight, which is very different from the traditional space sterilizer. It is easy to carry and
applicable to the disinfection of various different spaces such as operation theater, office,
laboratory and ambulance. With the precise hydrogen peroxide dosage and its user-friendly design,
the mini sterilizer can accomplish safe and efficient disinfection. ][78]

Ultrasonic Wound Debridement

The ultrasonic wound debridement is a medical equipment which is developed for complicated wound
debridement by using ultrasonic cavitation effect and mechanical effect of high frequency vibration.

Ice Therapy Machine for Shoulder

surgical procedures or trauma. ][80]

* [General Manufacturing][75]
  [General Manufacturing]
  
  ## General Manufacturing
  
  Manufacturing facilities and processes of all types require air compressors to optimize efficiency
  and speed throughout the assembly line.
  
  Air compressors facilitate specific processes such as:
  * Stamping
  * Clamping
  * Controls
  * Tool Powering
  
  [Contact Us][76]
* [Electronics][77]
  [Electronics]
  
  ## Electronics
  
  Production lines in the electronics industry and electronic devices themselves often depend on air
  compressors. Manufacturers often use compressed air for electronics applications due to its
  efficiency in energy conversion with minimal impact.
  
  Air compressors supply power for the following processes:
  * Desoldering
  * Printed circuit board (PCB) cleaning
  * Pick and place machine operation
  
  [Contact Us][78]
* [Medical Device Manufacturing][79]
  [Medical Device Manufacturing]
  
  ## Medical Device Manufacturing
  
  The medical industry frequently uses air compressors for powering tools and supplying air to
  patients under care. As a result, the applications in this industry require air compression
  systems that supply contaminant-free air.
  
  The medical industry used compressed air for applications such as:
  * Compressed air tools
  * Pressurized air for medical devices and assisted breathing
  * Laboratory use
  
  [Contact Us][80]
* [Medical Facilities][81]
  [Medical Facilities]
  
  ## Medical Facilities
  
  Many types of medical facilities use air compressors for applications including:
  * **Patient Air Supply:** Air compressors supply clean air for patients who have difficulty
    breathing on their own or are under sedation.
  * **Laboratory Use:** Air compressors power a variety of equipment, including blood analysis
    systems, oxygen generation equipment, x-rays and mammograms, nitrogen generation systems, and
    more.
  * **Duct System Air Filtration:** Duct and filtration systems use air compressors to supply clean
    and pure air.
  * **Handheld Medical Tool Power Supplies:** Surgical instruments use air compressors to power
    drilling, puncturing, and other operations.
  * **Equipment Sterilization:** Sterilization and cleaning systems use air compressors as power
    supplies.
  
  [Contact Us][82]
* [Auto Repair][83]
  [Auto Repair]
  
  ## Auto Repair
  
  Automotive applications use pneumatic tools to increase the efficiency and ease of assembly for
  automotive parts.
  
  These applications may use air compressors for the following:
  * Painting
  * Vehicle assembly
  * Engine construction
  * Shell construction
  * Cleaning
  
  [Contact Us][84]
* [Metalworking][85]
  [Metalworking]
  
  ## Metalworking
  
  The use of industrial air compressors in metalworking helps quickly fabricate high-quality metal
  parts to tight specifications for many types of products.
  
  Metalworking applications for air compressors include:
  * Tool activation and use
  * Finishing
  * Spraying
  * Shaping
  
  [Contact Us][86]
* [Plastic Molding][87]
  [Plastic Molding]
  
  ## Plastic Molding
  
  Hard synthetic plastic parts rely on air compressors for manufacturing processes.
  
  The following are some of the specific applications for air compressors in the plastic molding
  industry:
  * Mold-presses
  * Injection molding
  * Forming
  
  [Contact Us][88]
* [Chemical][89]
  [Chemical]
  
  ## Chemical
  
  The chemical and petrochemical industries use air compression equipment to maintain efficiency and
  safety when working with combustible and toxic gases.
  
  Applications for air compressors in the chemical industry include:
  * Safely moving products along assembly lines
  * Air moisture removal
  * Product cleaning
  * Maintaining dry environments
  * Controlling cylinders and valves
  * Separating nitrogen
  * Manufacturing urea, ammonia, fertilizer, and nitric acid
  * Controlling pneumatic valves
  * Safely operating fluid pumping systems to prevent potential explosions
  * Creating air curtains that make areas safer and cleaner
  
  [Contact Us][90]
* [Pharmaceutical][91]
  [Pharmaceutical]
  
  ## Pharmaceutical
  
  Pharmacies use air compression systems to meet FDA requirements for medicine production, equipment
  operation, and more.
  
  Specific pharmaceutical applications for air compressors include:
  * **Bottling, Packaging, and Canning: **Oil-free compressed air removes moisture and cleans
    various types of packaging, preventing contamination in packaging, bottling, and canning
    processes through the use of Class 0 air.
  * **Capsule and Tablet Manufacturing:** Manufacturing processes for tablet and capsule products
    use Class 0 compressed air. Some of these processes include pressing, drying, mixing, packaging,
    and coating.
  * **Gel, Ointment, Cream, and Syrup Manufacturing:** Vials, tubes, and other equipment require
    cleaning and drying before being filled with product. Oil-free air keeps these materials clean
    and contaminant free.
  * **Fermentation:** Air compressors produce sterile air that prevents contamination and pollution
    of bacteria that could compromise end products.
  * **Instrumentation Air:** Pneumatic conveying processes use compressed air to make contact with
    the product while avoiding contamination. Additionally, compressed air powers sorting systems,
    valves, and other equipment.
  
  [Contact Us][92]
* [Water & Sewage Treatment][93]
  [Water & Sewage Treatment]
  
  ## Water & Sewage Treatment
  
  Agitation processes use compressed air for suspending solids, while bacteria processing
  applications use compressed air for oxygen supplies.
  
  Other applications in this industry include:
  * **Back Washing Sand Filtration:** Compressed air loosens compacted material and expands filter
    beds. Systems can pump clean backwash water while suspending particles through filters before
    disposing of them.
  * **Desalination:** Wastewater treatment plants use air compressors to remove dissolved salts from
    water and generate fresh water for municipal or domestic use.
  * **Wastewater Disposal:** Central vacuum systems use air compressors to dispose of wastewater,
    allowing for the collection, drainage, and removal of wastewater at the same time.
  * **Digestion Tank Cleaning and Maintenance:** Wastewater treatment plants use digestion tanks,
    which rely on compressed air to mix oxygen and sludge to increase retention times and gas yield.
  * **Slurry Liquid Pumping:** Slurry liquid pumps use air compressors for power supplies to make
    transferring and removing slurry liquid easier.
  * **Suction Pressure:** Air compressors provide sufficient suction pressure to remove wastewater
    and clean sewage systems.
  * **Wastewater Purification:** Wastewater treatment plants use activated sludge tanks to save
    space and increase efficiency. These systems use air compressors to provide sufficient pressure
    that maximizes oxygen production for wastewater purification.
  
  [Contact Us][94]
* [Food & Beverage][95]
  [Food & Beverage]
  
  ## Food & Beverage
  
  The food and beverage industry uses air compressors to supply clean air for processes such as
  product storage, packaging, and processing.
  
  Other applications for air compressors in this industry include:
  * Bottling
  * Bakeries
  * Freezing products
  * Coffee automats
  * Food packaging and processing
  * Mixing products
  * French-fried vending machines
  * Dispensing soft drinks and draught beer
  * Hydrofors, i.e. water supply pressurization
  * Dispensing condiments
  
  [Contact Us][96]

* [General Manufacturing][75]
  [General Manufacturing]
  
  ## General Manufacturing
  
  Manufacturing facilities and processes of all types require air compressors to optimize efficiency
  and speed throughout the assembly line.
  
  Air compressors facilitate specific processes such as:
  * Stamping
  * Clamping
  * Controls
  * Tool Powering
  
  [Contact Us][76]
* [Electronics][77]
  [Electronics]
  
  ## Electronics
  
  Production lines in the electronics industry and electronic devices themselves often depend on air
  compressors. Manufacturers often use compressed air for electronics applications due to its
  efficiency in energy conversion with minimal impact.
  
  Air compressors supply power for the following processes:
  * Desoldering
  * Printed circuit board (PCB) cleaning
  * Pick and place machine operation
  
  [Contact Us][78]
* [Medical Device Manufacturing][79]
  [Medical Device Manufacturing]
  
  ## Medical Device Manufacturing
  
  The medical industry frequently uses air compressors for powering tools and supplying air to
  patients under care. As a result, the applications in this industry require air compression
  systems that supply contaminant-free air.
  
  The medical industry used compressed air for applications such as:
  * Compressed air tools
  * Pressurized air for medical devices and assisted breathing
  * Laboratory use
  
  [Contact Us][80]
* [Medical Facilities][81]
  [Medical Facilities]
  
  ## Medical Facilities
  
  Many types of medical facilities use air compressors for applications including:
  * **Patient Air Supply:** Air compressors supply clean air for patients who have difficulty
    breathing on their own or are under sedation.
  * **Laboratory Use:** Air compressors power a variety of equipment, including blood analysis
    systems, oxygen generation equipment, x-rays and mammograms, nitrogen generation systems, and
    more.
  * **Duct System Air Filtration:** Duct and filtration systems use air compressors to supply clean
    and pure air.
  * **Handheld Medical Tool Power Supplies:** Surgical instruments use air compressors to power
    drilling, puncturing, and other operations.
  * **Equipment Sterilization:** Sterilization and cleaning systems use air compressors as power
    supplies.
  
  [Contact Us][82]
* [Auto Repair][83]
  [Auto Repair]
  
  ## Auto Repair
  
  Automotive applications use pneumatic tools to increase the efficiency and ease of assembly for
  automotive parts.
  
  These applications may use air compressors for the following:
  * Painting
  * Vehicle assembly
  * Engine construction
  * Shell construction
  * Cleaning
  
  [Contact Us][84]
* [Metalworking][85]
  [Metalworking]
  
  ## Metalworking
  
  The use of industrial air compressors in metalworking helps quickly fabricate high-quality metal
  parts to tight specifications for many types of products.
  
  Metalworking applications for air compressors include:
  * Tool activation and use
  * Finishing
  * Spraying
  * Shaping
  
  [Contact Us][86]
* [Plastic Molding][87]
  [Plastic Molding]
  
  ## Plastic Molding
  
  Hard synthetic plastic parts rely on air compressors for manufacturing processes.
  
  The following are some of the specific applications for air compressors in the plastic molding
  industry:
  * Mold-presses
  * Injection molding
  * Forming
  
  [Contact Us][88]
* [Chemical][89]
  [Chemical]
  
  ## Chemical
  
  The chemical and petrochemical industries use air compression equipment to maintain efficiency and
  safety when working with combustible and toxic gases.
  
  Applications for air compressors in the chemical industry include:
  * Safely moving products along assembly lines
  * Air moisture removal
  * Product cleaning
  * Maintaining dry environments
  * Controlling cylinders and valves
  * Separating nitrogen
  * Manufacturing urea, ammonia, fertilizer, and nitric acid
  * Controlling pneumatic valves
  * Safely operating fluid pumping systems to prevent potential explosions
  * Creating air curtains that make areas safer and cleaner
  
  [Contact Us][90]
* [Pharmaceutical][91]
  [Pharmaceutical]
  
  ## Pharmaceutical
  
  Pharmacies use air compression systems to meet FDA requirements for medicine production, equipment
  operation, and more.
  
  Specific pharmaceutical applications for air compressors include:
  * **Bottling, Packaging, and Canning: **Oil-free compressed air removes moisture and cleans
    various types of packaging, preventing contamination in packaging, bottling, and canning
    processes through the use of Class 0 air.
  * **Capsule and Tablet Manufacturing:** Manufacturing processes for tablet and capsule products
    use Class 0 compressed air. Some of these processes include pressing, drying, mixing, packaging,
    and coating.
  * **Gel, Ointment, Cream, and Syrup Manufacturing:** Vials, tubes, and other equipment require
    cleaning and drying before being filled with product. Oil-free air keeps these materials clean
    and contaminant free.
  * **Fermentation:** Air compressors produce sterile air that prevents contamination and pollution
    of bacteria that could compromise end products.
  * **Instrumentation Air:** Pneumatic conveying processes use compressed air to make contact with
    the product while avoiding contamination. Additionally, compressed air powers sorting systems,
    valves, and other equipment.
  
  [Contact Us][92]
* [Water & Sewage Treatment][93]
  [Water & Sewage Treatment]
  
  ## Water & Sewage Treatment
  
  Agitation processes use compressed air for suspending solids, while bacteria processing
  applications use compressed air for oxygen supplies.
  
  Other applications in this industry include:
  * **Back Washing Sand Filtration:** Compressed air loosens compacted material and expands filter
    beds. Systems can pump clean backwash water while suspending particles through filters before
    disposing of them.
  * **Desalination:** Wastewater treatment plants use air compressors to remove dissolved salts from
    water and generate fresh water for municipal or domestic use.
  * **Wastewater Disposal:** Central vacuum systems use air compressors to dispose of wastewater,
    allowing for the collection, drainage, and removal of wastewater at the same time.
  * **Digestion Tank Cleaning and Maintenance:** Wastewater treatment plants use digestion tanks,
    which rely on compressed air to mix oxygen and sludge to increase retention times and gas yield.
  * **Slurry Liquid Pumping:** Slurry liquid pumps use air compressors for power supplies to make
    transferring and removing slurry liquid easier.
  * **Suction Pressure:** Air compressors provide sufficient suction pressure to remove wastewater
    and clean sewage systems.
  * **Wastewater Purification:** Wastewater treatment plants use activated sludge tanks to save
    space and increase efficiency. These systems use air compressors to provide sufficient pressure
    that maximizes oxygen production for wastewater purification.
  
  [Contact Us][94]
* [Food & Beverage][95]
  [Food & Beverage]
  
  ## Food & Beverage
  
  The food and beverage industry uses air compressors to supply clean air for processes such as
  product storage, packaging, and processing.
  
  Other applications for air compressors in this industry include:
  * Bottling
  * Bakeries
  * Freezing products
  * Coffee automats
  * Food packaging and processing
  * Mixing products
  * French-fried vending machines
  * Dispensing soft drinks and draught beer
  * Hydrofors, i.e. water supply pressurization
  * Dispensing condiments
  
  [Contact Us][96]

Real-time air quality data from over 80,000 monitoring sensors worldwide.

## **Klaus Hammes**

Visionary and pioneer in clean air

April 7, 1939 - April 30, 2026

With the passing of Klaus Hammes, IQAir has lost its visionary founder, who, from the 1960s through
the 1990s, improved air quality for people around the world through the innovative use of air filter
technology in buildings and vehicles. Klaus Hammes was a pioneer of the Indoor Air Quality (IAQ),
Cleantech and HealthTech industries and continues to inspire the work of IQAir to this day.

## Clean air solutions. Proven protection.

Trusted by hospitals, schools, and families worldwide, IQAir air purifiers remove ultrafine
particles down to 0.003 microns — the smallest particles that impact your health the most.
Experience cleaner, healthier air in every room.

just [**walk in**][89].

## **Klaus Hammes**

Visionary and pioneer in clean air

April 7, 1939 - April 30, 2026

With the passing of Klaus Hammes, IQAir has lost its visionary founder, who, from the 1960s through
the 1990s, improved air quality for people around the world through the innovative use of air filter
technology in buildings and vehicles. Klaus Hammes was a pioneer of the Indoor Air Quality (IAQ),
Cleantech and HealthTech industries and continues to inspire the work of IQAir to this day.

# [ **J.S.T.**Medical Medical *+* Dental *+* Veterinary ][10]

**J.S.T. Medical Ltd** offer a wide range of services including testing or repair to your radiology,
dental, general medical, physiotherapy and veterinary equipment

[icon heart]

## Medical

Service, repair, install and performance testing of all equipment to AS/NZS 3551

Full service and testing of sterilisers to AS/NZS 4187

[icon tooth]

## Dental

Service, repair, install and performance testing of all equipment to AS/NZS 3551

Full service and testing of sterilisers to AS/NZS 4187

[icon dog]

## Veterinary

Service, repair, install and performance testing of all equipment to AS/NZS 3551

Full service and testing of sterilisers to AS/NZS 4815

[ [melag steriliser]

## Authorised Melag steriliser distributors to most markets in NZ

][11]
[ [cattani compressor]

## We sell a range of new Cattani Suction and compressors

][12]
[ [browne steriliser monitor]

## We also stock Browne sterilisation monitoring items (Helix, Bowie Dick, Class 4, 5 & 6
## indicators) and various consumables

][13]

[Browse our online shop][14]

We cover **Hawke's Bay**, **Dannevirke** to **Wairoa**, and **Taupo**.

But if you are outside of these areas, please give us a call and we can discuss options.

We have many customers around the country who send their equipment to us for annual servicing and
testing.

[Jaime]

## Jaime

Jaime Taylor has over 20 years of experience in service/repair & testing medical equipment.
Qualifications include a City & Guilds in engineering ,trained Anaesthetic service technician,
Radiation Licence … No 20479, Electrical service technician - Licence No 264972 .

Jaime moved into the medical field in 1993, working for Siemens-South Africa, before arriving in
Napier, New Zealand in 1994.

After that he established J Taylor Medical Engineering which was changed to J.S.T. Medical Ltd in
2008.

Over the 20 year period factory technical training from various suppliers has been ongoing allowing
the company to service a wide variety of equipment & becoming authorised to service and test a wide
range of radiology, anaesthetic, medical, dental, physiotherapy and veterinary equipment.

Read
[James]

## James

James Taylor has been performance testing medical equipment for many years to AS/NZ 3551
specifications. From mid 2014 James joined Jaime to become a steriliser service technician, and has
since attended factory … training courses enabling him to service/repair dental suction units,
compressors and dental chairs.

Read
[ [Authorised service agents] ][15]
[ [Need gear installed or decommissioned?] ][16]
[ [Looking to buy second hand?] ][17]
[ [James & Jaime] ][18]

## Authorised service agents for...

**Dental plant equipment:** Cattani, Durr.

**Sterilisers:** Melag, Lisa-W/H, Mocom, Technogaz, Eschman, SciCan, Dac, Midmark, Runyes, Accord.

**Dental equipment:** Adec, Sirona, Belmont, Faro, Forrest.

## Need gear installed or decommissioned?

Then we're your guys! We can help you with install and decommissioning of radiology equipment and
following paper work. As well as dental chairs, suction unit, air compressors, sterilisers and much
more

## Looking to buy second hand?

If you're looking to buy any second hand gear we often have refurbished equipment, serviced and
tested autoclaves, dental chairs, x-ray units and more.

Please contact us to find out what we currently have in stock.

## Get in touch

If you have any questions or would like a chat, please contact us:
* Jaime - call or text 0274 784 228
* James - call or text 021 667 987
* send us an email:
* * [info@jstmedical.co.nz][19]
  * [jaime@jstmedical.co.nz][20]
  * [james@jstmedical.co.nz][21]

Our workshop is located at:
* Unit 4, 40 Cadbury Road, Onekawa, Napier, 4110
  ([view on Google Maps][22])

Please contact us for our workshop hours.

Our P.O. Box is 1039 Napier 4140

 

## Spare parts

If you are a technician needing to purchase Melag spare parts then please email us and ask for an
account form.

Already a have an account and are looking to login then click **[here][23]**

## Thank you!

We've received your message and will get back to you as soon as possible.

**Jaime** and **James**.

## Uh oh...

It looks like there's an error with your form submission - please refresh the page and try again.

If you still have no luck, please contact us another way. We apologise for the inconvenience.

## Drop us a line

## Our Team

SASELUX is a professional** **manufacturer and exporter of emergency lighting products, which are
produced in China factory and sold to different countries with factory price and satisfied
services**.** We assist in creating bright and safety lighting environment.

“Honesty, Reliability, Innovation, and Enterprising” as our core values have enabled our company to
develop in the field of emergency lighting all the time and win some honors. We have always adhered
to the market-oriented strategy, constantly optimizing products and improving technologies. We have
been committed to providing customers with the best quality, competitive price, and considerate
services. Our team is professional and patient. We can solve problems of customers very well. So if
you have any question about our products, just please contact us. In order to create the best brand
and improve the service, we are keeping on increasing our enterprise scale and improving the core
competence.

Our office is at No.11018, Yikang, Huarong Road, Dalang, Longhua, Shenzhen, China. Our manager Mr.
Zhang and all staff warmly welcome you to visit our company and build a long term business
relationship.

## Our Team

SASELUX is a professional** **manufacturer and exporter of emergency lighting products, which are
produced in China factory and sold to different countries with factory price and satisfied
services**.** We assist in creating bright and safety lighting environment.

“Honesty, Reliability, Innovation, and Enterprising” as our core values have enabled our company to
develop in the field of emergency lighting all the time and win some honors. We have always adhered
to the market-oriented strategy, constantly optimizing products and improving technologies. We have
been committed to providing customers with the best quality, competitive price, and considerate
services. Our team is professional and patient. We can solve problems of customers very well. So if
you have any question about our products, just please contact us. In order to create the best brand
and improve the service, we are keeping on increasing our enterprise scale and improving the core
competence.

Our office is at No.11018, Yikang, Huarong Road, Dalang, Longhua, Shenzhen, China. Our manager Mr.
Zhang and all staff warmly welcome you to visit our company and build a long term business
relationship.

# Safeguarding Global Health®

## with every product we sterilize

**Sterigenics** is a global leader in comprehensive sterilization solutions meeting industrial
sterilization needs in the medical device, pharmaceutical, advanced applications, commercial, and
food industries.

[Contact Us][79]

## We are prepared to partner with you
## when and where you need us.

We can support all your needs from product conception to
commercialization to ensure the safety of your product and your process.

## Sterigenics offers:

[[An award icon for quality.]][80]

### [Safety and quality][81]

Best-in-class, in-house expertise across engineering, regulatory, and EH&S ensures consistent
quality and reliability to provide you with the confidence you want.

[Learn About Our Safety & Quality Standards & QMS Certs ][82]
[[Global Integrated Network Icon]][83]

### [Global integrated network][84]

Our operations span 48 facilities in 13 countries, providing the flexibility and redundancy to meet
all of your contract sterilization needs.

[See Our Global Locations ][85]
[[An icon of a human head in front of a light bulb signaling knowledge and expertise.]][86]

### [Industry-leading experts][87]

We are over 1,600 engineers, scientists, safety specialists, and solution providers with more than
90 years of deep expertise across Gamma, Ethylene Oxide, Electron beam, and X-ray sterilization.

[Meet Our Experts ][88]
[[A hand icon holding a clock]][89]

### [Outstanding service ][90]

We are driven to fulfill our customers’ needs in a timely fashion and with the highest quality and
care and provide innovative resources and support to do so.

[Discover Our Superior Service ][91]
